claude code version 2.0.35 and latest 2.1.42 with all models give error: 

w/ Search the web Option:

w/o Search the web Option:
configurations.0.code_execution_20250825.use_web_search_purpose: Extra inputs are not permitted

### What Should Happen?

no error

### Error Messages/Logs

```shell
configurations.1.code_execution_20250825.use_web_search_purpose: Extra inputs are not permitted

configurations.0.code_execution_20250825.use_web_search_purpose: Extra inputs are not permitted
```

open Claude
send message

Yes, this worked in a previous version
